deferred.reason: Large student/admin/superadmin routes and presentation components were reviewed in relevant sections only; remaining product paths were not completely audited.

explicitExclusions.reason: Dependencies were not exhaustively audited or queried against vulnerability databases.
Only the authorized current local state was analyzed, not history.
Generated review artifacts are not product source.

openQuestions.question: Which real order/payment IDs were charged but remained created/failed, and what were the provider capture/webhook-delivery states? A production operator should reconcile using IDs only; this review did not access those records.
Is the embedded database credential already revoked, and what privileges did its role hold? Do not validate by using the leaked value.

Are successful checkout signatures guaranteed to represent captured funds under the deployed gateway configuration? The current verify handler checks HMAC but does not query capture/amount/currency state.

What is the approved refund/chargeback/fee-waiver policy? Current source handles only payment.captured/payment.failed, contains no refund event reconciliation, and checks payment on pending login/approval rather than ongoing entitlement.

HOD payment notice email failure is caught after the paid write; retries of already-paid events do not resend. Should approval notices use a durable outbox? This affects awareness, not stored payment success.

The generic API client overwrites explicit Authorization headers with a stored session token. App startup/signout normally clears stale sessions, so ordinary payment-flow reachability is not established; do not treat this as a confirmed incident cause.
Tracked old demo environment values have no current VITE_DEMO consumers. Their live credential status is unknown and should be reviewed by the owner without reproducing values.

surfaces.label: Payment confirmation and checkout recovery
surfaces.notes: Two directly reproduced payment-state failures. Browser state only stores success payload in callback memory, offers no confirm-status retry/polling, and tells uncertain applicants to contact HOD. Current routes expose only create-order, verify and webhook; no gateway reconciliation endpoint was found. The 30-minute reuse cutoff can create another order while old unconfirmed orders still exist; do not advise affected users to pay again until provider status is reconciled.

surfaces.label: Session, registration/reset and approval controls
surfaces.notes: HS256 allowlist, server-resolved account/session state, separation of payment/session tokens, payment row ownership and actual user IDs checked. Login/approval use any paid row rather than latest attempt. Trusted account provisioning intentionally bypasses payment. No additional exploitable bypass substantiated in inspected paths.

surfaces.label: Current tracked credential exposure
surfaces.notes: 14 credential-bearing scripts independently confirmed with values redacted. No credential was used or validated. The normal production start path does not call these helpers.

surfaces.label: Clinical work insert/update errors
surfaces.notes: Both raw console error sinks confirmed. Other large student route sections were not exhaustively reviewed.

surfaces.label: HOD/admin permanent account deletion
surfaces.notes: Payment deletion and unknown-order acknowledgment reproduced using synthetic data; no privilege escalation claimed.

surfaces.label: Remaining repository paths and deployment state
surfaces.notes: Broad sampling is not an exhaustive audit. Live provider subscriptions, captures/refunds/settlement, secret rotation and production log policy were not inspected.
